title: The Two Mintings of Harrow Hollow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=10 beats='Idris is helping weigh grain at a family stall at the harvest swap-market when the price drift between sunwheel and sheaf tokens is first noticed.'>>

choices.label: Start asking questions about the tokens

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=10 beats='Idris sets down the scale and looks around the market, trying to decide where to begin.'>>

choices.label: Walk out into the market rows

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=10 beats='The rows of stalls are busy with harvest trading, tokens clinking from hand to hand.'>>

choices.label: Watch the trading for a moment

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=10 beats='A pattern in the prices starts to nag at Idris, too odd to be a coincidence.'>>

choices.label: Decide how to look into it

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='At the harvest swap-market Idris notices rye bread costs three sunwheel tokens at one stall but four sheaf tokens at the next, though the two token kinds are supposed to trade evenly; Idris must decide how to start figuring out why.'>>

choices.label: Ask Auntie Resh about the tokens
Compare prices at every stall
Follow the cart to the token-smith shed

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='Auntie Resh the token-smith turns a sheaf token over in her fingers and admits she has noticed the drift too, saying a second minting went out this season that looks almost identical to the first.'>>

choices.label: Help Auntie Resh weigh the tokens right away
Ask who minted the second batch
Bring the question straight to Old Ban

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='Walking stall to stall with a wax slate, Idris finds sellers near the east gate quietly charging less for sheaf tokens than sellers near the well, though none of them seem to know why.'>>

choices.label: Post the price pattern by the well
Ask the east-gate sellers directly
Take the pattern straight to Old Ban

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='Idris trails a cart loaded with blank token disks toward a shed at the edge of the market where the press that stamps new tokens is kept.'>>

choices.label: Ask to see inside the minting press
Wait and watch who visits the shed
Fetch Auntie Resh to look at the press

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='With the tokens finally laid out together, Idris and the others who came along get ready to settle the question of the two mintings once and for all.'>>

choices.label: Weigh the tokens side by side
Ask Auntie Resh to explain the batch
Invite Old Ban to see the results

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='The mark near the rim of the newer tokens points toward a specific press, and Idris wants to know exactly who has been running it this season.'>>

choices.label: Trace the mark to the new press
Ask the token-smith who runs it
Compare the mark to older tokens

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='Old Ban the market steward listens carefully as Idris lays out everything found so far about the two mintings and asks what should happen next.'>>

choices.label: Lay out everything found so far
Suggest a public weighing station
Ask Old Ban to check mint records

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=90 beats='Curiosity about the shed and the east-gate sellers pulls in more of the market, and Idris has to decide how to answer everyone at once.'>>

choices.label: Call a market-wide meeting
Post a running chart by the gate
Set up a public weighing for everyone

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Idris and Auntie Resh set the scales right there at her cart; every sunwheel and sheaf token balances exactly even, and word of the fair weigh-in spreads through the market before the afternoon is out.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Auntie Resh explains the sheaf tokens simply came from a newer batch stamped upriver this season; once sellers hear the plain explanation, they stop treating the newer tokens as worth less.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Old Ban confirms the weigh-in results in front of the whole market, and the honest, ordinary explanation settles the matter for good.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Tracing the mark leads straight to the new press upriver, and once the source is named plainly, the price drift stops mattering to anyone.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The token-smith who runs the new press explains the batch was simply pressed a little later this season, nothing more mysterious than that.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Comparing the marks side by side shows the two mintings really are worth exactly the same, though it takes a careful eye to tell them apart.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Old Ban thanks Idris for bringing everything together so clearly, and the steward takes it from there with the whole market watching.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The public weighing station becomes a regular fixture of market days, and trust in both kinds of tokens is fully restored by the next harvest swap.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Old Ban matches the odd batch to specific delivery days in the mint records, closing the question with proof anyone can check.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The market meeting runs long, and by the time everyone agrees on what to do, a few sellers have already grown wary of the newer tokens.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The chart posted by the gate goes mostly unread for the first few days, and the price drift lingers longer than it should before finally fading.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The public weighing draws a curious crowd, and seeing the tokens balance evenly convinces almost everyone at the market by the end of the day.'>>
